exposure: Grade I CSP (GS embedded in less than one-half thickness of the lower anterior corpus)
Grade II CSP (GS extended to more than one-half thickness of overlying myometrium)
Grade III CSP (GS bulged out of the cesarean scar)
Grade IV CSP (GS became an amorphous tumor with rich vascularity at the cesarean scar)
finding: A novel ultrasound grading system for CSP was developed and found to be associated with the invasiveness of surgery required.
